title: Wisdom after the thief escapes
literal_meaning: Sense emerges after the thief has fled.
meaning_odia: ଚୋର ପଳାଇଯିବା ପରେ କ’ଣ କରିବାର ଥିଲା ସେ ବୁଦ୍ଧି ଆସୁଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଦରକାର ଥିବା ବୁଝାମଣା ଘଟଣା ସରିବା ପରେ ଆସିବାକୁ କଥାଟି ବିଦ୍ରୂପ କରୁଛି। ଏହାର ଜୋର ବୁଦ୍ଧିର ଅଭାବ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ବୁଦ୍ଧି ଆସିବାର ବିଳମ୍ବ ଉପରେ।
explanation: The thief has already escaped when the useful thought finally arrives. Read editorially, the line mocks hindsight that appears too late to change that moment. It can be rueful or teasing: the answer seems clear only once the opportunity to act has passed.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After an avoidable mix-up is over, everyone suddenly explains the simple check that would have caught it beforehand. Someone compares their late insight to sense arriving after the thief has fled.
cultural_context: The word ପରେ fixes the order: escape first, understanding afterward. That compact reversal of useful timing carries the saying’s sting.
